news.titleEn: S&P 500 futures are little changed after mixed session; traders await bank earnings: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: US stocks finished mixed on Monday as a chip selloff led by Micron dragged the Nasdaq down 0.44%, and Asian tech shares fell sharply on Tuesday morning.
news.conclusionZh: 芯片股领跌，美股涨跌互现，亚洲科技股周二开盘大跌
news.whyEn: The chip selloff is spreading globally just before bank earnings and US inflation data, so tech-heavy portfolios and Asian markets are most exposed.
news.whyZh: 芯片抛售蔓延全球，正好碰上财报季和通胀数据，科技股和亚洲市场首当其冲
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 slipped 0.06% to 7,807.24 and the Nasdaq fell 0.44%, while the Dow rose 0.38% on a 2% gain in Salesforce after a Bank of America double upgrade. Micron dropped 3.9% as investors weighed rising competition from China's CXMT, which reported progress on a new chip structure. On Tuesday South Korea's Kospi opened down more than 3%, with SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics each losing over 5%, and Japan's Kioxia, Advantest and SoftBank also slid. The US bond market was shut for Columbus Day, so the 10-year Treasury yield stayed near 5.24%.
news.detailZh: 标普500指数微跌0.06%，收于7807.24点，纳指跌0.44%；道指涨0.38%，主要靠Salesforce被美银连升两级后上涨2%。美光跌3.9%，因为中国长鑫存储（CXMT）称新芯片结构取得进展，市场担心竞争加剧。周二韩国Kospi开盘跌逾3%，SK海力士和三星电子跌幅都超过5%，日本铠侠、爱德万和软银也大跌。美债市场因哥伦布日休市，10年期收益率维持在5.24%附近。

news.titleEn: Oil prices today: Brent, WTI rise
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude rose 1.8% to $106.65 a barrel after deadly Houthi attacks on Riyadh's airport and new Russian strikes on Ukraine's energy facilities.
news.conclusionZh: 中东和俄乌局势升级，布伦特原油涨至106.65美元
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 keeps inflation pressure high, which makes rate cuts harder and hits airlines, transport companies and energy-importing countries.
news.whyZh: 油价持续破百推高通胀，降息更难，航空、运输业和能源进口国受影响最大
news.detailEn: Brent futures settled at $106.65 and US WTI gained 2% to $93.74. The rally came after Houthi missiles hit King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, and as Ukraine said Russia was still attacking its energy infrastructure. About 1.2 million barrels a day of US Gulf of Mexico output also remained shut in after Hurricane Isaias. With supply risks coming from several directions at once, traders are watching this week's US CPI to see how much of the energy shock reaches consumer prices.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油期货收于每桶106.65美元，美国WTI涨2%至93.74美元。上涨的直接原因是胡塞武装导弹击中利雅得哈立德国王国际机场，同时乌克兰称俄罗斯仍在打击其能源设施。受飓风「伊萨亚斯」影响，美国墨西哥湾约每日120万桶产量仍处于关停状态。多个方向同时出现供应风险，交易员正关注本周美国CPI，看能源冲击有多少传导到了消费价格。

news.titleEn: Iran sets crosshairs on 'US-UAE' oil shuttle out of Strait of Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: Iran's security chief said the US-backed shuttle system that moves Gulf oil around the Strait of Hormuz is now an explicit target, and claimed Iran hits several such ships every night.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗宣布把美国支持的霍尔木兹「绕行运油」船队列为攻击目标
news.whyEn: The shuttle route is one of the few ways Gulf crude still reaches the market, so attacks on it push up freight costs and global oil supply risk.
news.whyZh: 这条绕行航线是海湾原油少数的出口通道，遭袭会推高运费和全球供应风险
news.detailEn: Mohsen Rezaei said the system, which uses smaller vessels to carry crude to larger tankers off Oman's coast, is "smuggling" because the strait is under Iran's control. At least 15 ships have been targeted in October, and 87% of vessels hit in the third quarter were tankers. Freight now eats up 25-30% of the price of Gulf crude, compared with 1-3% before the war, forcing sellers to offer discounts of up to $35 a barrel. Tehran says the attacks will continue until the US lifts its naval blockade of Iranian ports, and earlier Iranian officials called the latest US response to Iran's Hormuz proposal insufficient.
news.detailZh: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书穆赫辛·雷扎伊表示，这套用小船把原油转运到阿曼沿海大型油轮上的系统属于「走私」，因为海峡由伊朗控制。10月以来至少已有15艘船遇袭，三季度被击中的船只中87%是油轮。海湾原油的运费已占油价的25-30%，战前只有1-3%，卖家被迫每桶最多折价35美元。德黑兰称，在美国解除对伊朗港口的海上封锁之前袭击不会停止，伊朗官员此前还称美方对伊朗霍尔木兹方案的回应「不够」。

news.titleEn: Stumbling Equity Rally Hinges on Earnings for Year-End Boost
news.conclusionEn: Third-quarter earnings season starts Tuesday with JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citi and Wells Fargo, and analysts expect S&P 500 profits to jump about 25% from a year ago.
news.conclusionZh: 美股三季度财报季周二由大银行开启，预计盈利增约25%
news.whyEn: With yields at 20-year highs and oil above $100, strong earnings are the main thing that could support stocks into year-end.
news.whyZh: 美债收益率和油价都处高位，强劲盈利几乎是支撑美股年底行情的唯一动力
news.detailEn: Global stocks have stalled amid the chip selloff, the Iran war and the 10-year Treasury yield sitting above 5%. Wall Street expects a roughly 25% rise in S&P 500 profits, a high bar that leaves little room for disappointment. Bank results will be closely read for loan demand, trading revenue and how borrowers are coping with higher rates, especially since the bank stock index has dropped about 13% from its August peak. US CPI data later this week could also shape how much more the Fed tightens.
news.detailZh: 受芯片股抛售、伊朗战争以及10年期美债收益率突破5%影响，全球股市涨势停滞。华尔街预计标普500成分股盈利同比增长约25%，预期很高，几乎容不下失望。银行财报会被重点解读贷款需求、交易收入，以及借款人能否承受高利率；银行股指数已较8月高点回落约13%。本周晚些时候公布的美国CPI也可能影响美联储进一步收紧的力度。

news.titleEn: Houthi missile attack targets Saudi capital Riyadh for third day in a row
news.conclusionEn: Yemen's Houthis fired missiles at Riyadh for a third straight day after strikes on the city's main airport killed at least 14 people over the weekend.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装连续第三天导弹袭击利雅得，周末机场遇袭已致至少14死
news.whyEn: Repeated strikes on Saudi Arabia, the world's top oil exporter, widen the Gulf war and keep air travel and energy markets on edge.
news.whyZh: 全球最大石油出口国接连遇袭，海湾战事外溢，航空和能源市场持续紧张
news.detailEn: Saudi forces said they intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh and two more fired at Khamis Mushait. Saturday's strike on King Khalid International Airport killed at least 13 people and injured over 300, and another hit on Sunday killed one more. The airport will stay closed until Saturday, and airlines including Etihad, Gulf Air and Delta have suspended or delayed flights to Saudi cities. Iran's foreign minister has urged Riyadh to choose diplomacy, while Saudi authorities investigate why air defences failed to stop missiles that flew more than 1,000 km.
news.detailZh: 沙特方面称拦截了一枚射向利雅得的弹道导弹，以及两枚射向海米斯穆谢特的导弹。周六哈立德国王国际机场遇袭至少13人死亡、300多人受伤，周日再次遇袭又致1人死亡。机场将关闭到周六，阿提哈德、海湾航空和达美等航空公司已暂停或推迟飞往沙特的航班。伊朗外长呼吁沙特走外交路线，沙特当局则在调查为何防空系统没能拦住飞行超过1000公里的导弹。

news.titleEn: Ukraine's Zelenskyy accuses Russia of violating Trump's 'energy ceasefire'
news.conclusionEn: Zelenskyy said Russia has already broken the energy truce Trump announced over the weekend, and the EU responded with its largest-ever expansion of sanctions on Russia.
news.conclusionZh: 泽连斯基称俄罗斯已违反特朗普宣布的「能源停火」，欧盟大规模加码制裁
news.whyEn: If the truce collapses, attacks on refineries and power plants could resume, adding to the energy supply shock Europe is already facing this winter.
news.whyZh: 停火一旦破裂，炼厂和电厂遇袭会加剧欧洲今冬本已紧张的能源供应
news.detailEn: Zelenskyy said Moscow struck several power facilities, including a plant in Kharkiv, and warned Ukraine would respond if Russia does not honour the truce. The Kremlin confirmed talks on an energy ceasefire but rejected Kyiv's idea of a 60-day halt to allow elections. Trump announced the deal on Truth Social before either side confirmed it, which caused confusion. The EU added about 1,600 new sanctions listings targeting Russia's military-industrial complex, and leaders including Macron and Tusk said they saw no sign of Russian compliance.
news.detailZh: 泽连斯基称俄方打击了包括哈尔科夫一座电厂在内的多处电力设施，并警告如果俄罗斯不遵守停火，乌克兰将会回击。克里姆林宫承认双方在谈能源停火，但拒绝了基辅提出的停火60天以便举行选举的方案。特朗普在双方都没确认之前就在Truth Social上宣布了这项协议，造成混乱。欧盟新增约1600项针对俄罗斯军工体系的制裁，马克龙和图斯克等领导人都表示没看到俄方遵守停火的迹象。

news.titleEn: Demand for Crude Oil May Have Peaked Last Year, FGE Says
news.conclusionEn: Energy consultancy FGE NexantECA said global crude oil demand may have peaked in 2025, as the Iran war speeds up the shift to biofuels and other alternatives.
news.conclusionZh: 能源咨询机构FGE称全球原油需求可能已在2025年见顶
news.whyEn: A demand peak would change the long-term outlook for oil producers, energy stocks and oil-dependent economies, even while prices are high now.
news.whyZh: 需求见顶会改变产油国、能源股和石油依赖型经济的长期前景，即使眼下油价很高
news.detailEn: FGE argues that the price shock from the Iran war has accelerated structural changes, with more fuel demand being met by biofuels instead of crude. It also sees China's crude imports peaking next year at around 11.2 million barrels a day. The view highlights a split in the market: short-term supply disruptions are pushing prices up, while long-term demand may already be shrinking. That gap matters for decisions about new oil projects and how energy companies are valued.
news.detailZh: FGE认为，伊朗战争带来的油价冲击加速了结构性转变，越来越多的燃料需求由生物燃料而不是原油来满足。它还预计中国原油进口量将在明年见顶，约为每日1120万桶。这个观点说明市场出现了分化：短期供应中断推高油价，而长期需求可能已经开始萎缩。这对新油田项目的投资决策和能源公司的估值都很重要。

news.titleEn: Modi's Free Trade Push Could Lead to $140 Billion GDP Gain for India
news.conclusionEn: India's recent wave of free trade agreements could add about $140 billion to its GDP by 2035 by opening markets, cutting import costs and attracting foreign investment.
news.conclusionZh: 印度自贸协定攻势预计到2035年可为GDP增加约1400亿美元
news.whyEn: As companies diversify supply chains away from China, India's trade deals make it a bigger destination for manufacturing and investment.
news.whyZh: 企业正在分散对中国的供应链依赖，印度的自贸协定让它更能吸引制造业和投资
news.detailEn: The estimate covers the trade pacts India has signed under Prime Minister Modi, including its landmark agreement with the European Union. The gains are expected to come from new export markets, cheaper imported inputs, more foreign direct investment and higher productivity. India has long been one of the more protectionist major economies, so the shift is significant. How fast the benefits arrive will depend on how the deals are implemented and whether Indian industry can compete.
news.detailZh: 这一估算涵盖莫迪执政期间印度签署的多项贸易协定，包括与欧盟达成的标志性协议。收益预计来自新的出口市场、更便宜的进口原料、更多外国直接投资以及生产率提升。印度长期以来是保护主义色彩较重的大型经济体，这一转向意义重大。收益多快兑现，要看协议如何落地，以及印度本土产业能否经受竞争。

news.titleEn: Ethiopian forces enter strategic Tigray town of Adwa, witnesses say
news.conclusionEn: Ethiopian federal forces and an allied militia entered the strategic Tigray town of Adwa without a fight after Tigrayan fighters withdrew.
news.conclusionZh: 埃塞俄比亚联邦军队未经战斗进入提格雷战略重镇阿杜瓦
news.whyEn: Renewed fighting in Tigray, close to the Eritrean border, raises the risk of a wider conflict in the Horn of Africa near key Red Sea shipping routes.
news.whyZh: 提格雷战事重燃且靠近厄立特里亚边境，非洲之角冲突扩大的风险上升，还靠近红海航道
news.detailEn: Residents said federal troops and allied fighters entered Adwa on Sunday, a day after fighters from the Tigray People's Liberation Front pulled out. Adwa is one of Tigray's most important towns, both strategically and historically. The move follows reports of Eritrean troops inside northern Ethiopia, which has increased fears of a return to the 2020-2022 war. A wider conflict could deepen the humanitarian crisis and add to instability around the Red Sea.
news.detailZh: 居民称，提格雷人民解放阵线武装周六撤出阿杜瓦，联邦军队和盟友武装周日随即进城。阿杜瓦是提格雷地区战略和历史意义都很重要的城镇。此前已有报道称厄立特里亚军队出现在埃塞俄比亚北部，外界担心2020-2022年的战争会重演。冲突一旦扩大，人道危机会加深，红海周边局势也会更不稳定。

businessTips.explanationEn: Goodhart's Law says that when a measure becomes a target, it stops being a good measure. Once people are rewarded for hitting a number, they find ways to move the number without improving the thing it was meant to track. It is useful because it reminds managers to pair metrics with judgment and to watch for gaming.
businessTips.explanationZh: 古德哈特定律指的是：一个指标一旦变成考核目标，就不再是好指标。人们因为达标而受奖励后，会想办法把数字做上去，而不一定改善了这个数字原本要反映的东西。它提醒管理者把指标和判断结合起来，并留意有没有人在「刷数据」。
businessTips.exampleEn: A support team judged only on average call length starts rushing customers off the phone, so the metric improves while satisfaction falls. A better approach is to track call length together with resolution rate and customer ratings.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个客服团队只按平均通话时长考核，结果客服开始催客户挂电话，指标好看了，满意度却下降了。更好的做法是把通话时长、问题解决率和客户评分放在一起看。

businessTips.explanationEn: A productized service packages freelance work into a fixed scope, fixed price and fixed delivery time, like a product on a menu. Instead of quoting every project from scratch, you sell the same clearly defined offer again and again. This makes the work easier to sell, easier to deliver and much easier to scale or hand off to others.
businessTips.explanationZh: 产品化服务是把自由职业的工作打包成固定范围、固定价格、固定交付时间的标准套餐，就像菜单上的一道菜。你不再每个项目都从头报价，而是反复卖同一个定义清楚的服务。这样更好卖、更好交付，也更容易扩大规模或交给别人做。
businessTips.exampleEn: A designer stops taking custom projects and instead offers "5 Instagram post templates in your brand style, delivered in 3 days, for $300." Clients know exactly what they get, and the designer can reuse a tested workflow every time.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位设计师不再接定制项目，而是推出「按你的品牌风格做5个Instagram帖子模板，3天交付，300美元」。客户清楚知道自己能得到什么，设计师每次都能沿用成熟的流程。

businessTips.explanationEn: An earnings surprise is the gap between a company's reported profit and what analysts expected; forward guidance is management's outlook for coming quarters. Stock prices react to how results compare with expectations, not to whether profits are simply good or bad. Guidance often matters more than the past quarter because markets price in the future.
businessTips.explanationZh: 盈利意外是公司实际公布的利润与分析师预期之间的差距；前瞻指引是管理层对未来几个季度的展望。股价看的是业绩和预期相比如何，而不是利润本身是好是坏。指引往往比刚过去的季度更重要，因为市场交易的是未来。
businessTips.exampleEn: This earnings season analysts expect S&P 500 profits to grow about 25%, so a bank that grows profits 20% could still see its stock fall. If it also lowers its outlook for loan income, the drop can be larger, even though the quarter itself was profitable.
businessTips.exampleZh: 这个财报季分析师预计标普500盈利增长约25%，所以一家利润增长20%的银行股价仍可能下跌。如果它同时下调了贷款收入的展望，即使这个季度本身赚钱，股价也可能跌得更多。
